records.name: Spark Gemling benchmark
records.hypothesis: Use as the performance and usability benchmark that experimental candidates must beat or meaningfully differentiate from.
failure_modes: May dominate candidates because its established scaling is better documented.

records.name: Permafrost Crossbow campaign baseline
records.hypothesis: Campaign baseline for low-input crossbow gameplay and later comparison with Gemling quality interactions.
failure_modes: Boss damage may fall behind campaign clear.
Crossbow or ammunition dependency may constrain scaling.

records.name: Ball Lightning Gemling
records.hypothesis: High hit-frequency projectile mechanics may create quality and support scaling opportunities.
failure_modes: May require positioning or secondary setup.
